text:
aj: Quick follow-up from the RFC — streaming frame model change. Proposal: introduce an opt-in header `X-RI-Stream: event|legacy` and ship a tiny runtime sidecar that translates old chunked frames into the new event stream for legacy clients. Need rollout plan, who owns the sidecar, telemetry signals, and clear rollback triggers.

devon: +1 to sidecar approach. Keeps gateway simple. I'm leaning eng-runtime ownership for the sidecar code + container.

maria: Concern: how will the sidecar handle client backpressure and ordering guarantees? If we reorder frames during translation we could break clients.

olivia: We should define the exact metrics we'll watch during canary: `streaming.event.latency_99`, `streaming.event.error_rate`, `streaming.token_delta_ratio` (how many extra tokens produced vs legacy). Also capture per-tenant regressions.

kai: Example header and gateway rule I tested locally: 
```
# client -> gateway header
X-RI-Stream: event

# nginx example routing pseudo-rule
if ($http_x_ri_stream = "event") {
  proxy_pass http://sidecar:8080;
} else {
  proxy_pass http://runtime:8080;
}
```
This lets us route only opted-in requests to the translator.

sam: Rollback plan thoughts: 1) flip feature flag at gateway to route everything to runtime, 2) kill sidecar deployment, 3) auto-scale down related canary pools. We should automize steps in infra-runbook.

devon: +1. Add automatic health checks that detect sustained 5xx increase or 99p latency regressions > 30% over baseline for 5m to trigger flag rollback.

aj: @devon please propose a short list of thresholds. @olivia can you add the metric names to the observability dashboard and set default alerts?

olivia: Will do. Proposed thresholds: error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR latency_99 > baseline * 1.3 for 5m OR token_delta_ratio > 1.15 for 10m. I'll add per-tenant burn-in alert too.

maria: Can we make the sidecar idempotent and track translation version in a small header (`X-RI-Translate-Version`) so we can correlate logs to translation code?

kai: Yeah sidecar should inject `X-RI-Translate-Version: v1` on proxied requests and echo it in responses. That will help pulls for incident triage.

deploybot: canary: sidecar v1 rolled to canary cluster (10% traffic) at 1769460200 — monitoring enabled :eyes:

aj: Nice. Ownership proposal: eng-runtime owns sidecar impl + image; eng-infra owns deployment automation and rollout gates; eng-platform owns gateway feature flag integration and docs; product owns customer comms if we flip global default.

sam: Volunteers: I can take infra runbook + rollback automation. @devon you ok to own sidecar code module?

devon: Yep. I'll open a repo `ri-stream-sidecar` and a short RFC addendum with an interface spec.

maria: One more ops note: cache TTLs for any translated frames must be conservative. If sidecar changes framing, cached responses could be incompatible. Recommend TTL = 0 for first 48h canary window.

aj: Good call. I'll create RFC addendum and link this thread. Final ask: everyone drop any extra concerns here before EOD so we can triage into concrete tickets. :thumbsup:
